1.App k andr apna financial year kaise change krte hai?
apne APP ko open kriye front page per upar right hand side corner per CALENDAR bna hua hai uspar click kriye or apna financial year select kar ke submit kr dijiye.
2.online payment krne k liye bank details kaise dekhe ?

APP ke front page per right hand side niche ki taraf MORE ka option diya hua hai usi per click kre or dekhiye vahan per BANK DETAILS ka box bna hua hai usi per click kre apko apki bank detail dekhegi or easily aap payment kr skte hai.
3.mai apne stock ka tracking and delivery kaise check kru ?
SORRY ; aap apne stock ka TRACKING and DELIVERY is APP ke through nhi check kar sakte hai uske liye apko SSS OFFICE mai call krna pdega.
4.app ko ek contact no se use krk dusare contact no se bhi use kr skte h kya?
NO ; SSS APP ko ek hi CONTACT NO se USE kiya jaa sakta hai.
5.ek contact no se multiple phone m app use kr skte hai kya ?
YES ; SSS APP ko ek CONTACT NO se MULTIPLE PHONE mai APP USE kr sakte hai.
6.ledger report k ander mai CLEAR or UNCLEAR entry kaise check kru ?

Front page per ek LEDGER ka option arha hai us per click kriye apka ledger open ho jayega or usi ledger mai aap sbse uper right hand side corner wale icon par click kriye fir usme select kr dijiye CLEAR ENTRY or UNCLEAR ENTRY fir niche option diya hua hai APPLY us per click ker dijiye apki report open ho jayegi.
7.sss sale bill kaise dekha jata hai ?

Front page per ek SALE REPORT ka option arha hai us per click kriye apka sale report open hojaega usme particular koi ek SALE BILL NO dekhiye or usk SALE BILL NO KE LINk per click kr dijiye apka SALE BILL OPEN ho jayega.
8.supplier ka purchase bill kaise dekh skte hai?

Front page per SALE REPORT ka option arha hai us per click kriye apki sale report open ho jane k baad usme particular koi ek SALE BILL NO ka column dekhiye us column ke ander down arrow per click kriye click karte hi report open hogi jisme apko PURCHASE NO dikhega fir uske PURCHASE NO KE LINK per click ker dijiye apko apke SUPPLIER ka PURCHASE BILL dikh jayega.
9.Sale report ko BRAND WISE, TRANSPORT WISE kaise dekh skte hai ?

Front page per SALE REPORT ke option ko click kriye apka sale report open ho jayega uske uper right hand side corner per filer par click kriye fir usme select kr dijiye BRAND NAME or TRANSPORT fir niche diye APPLY us per click ker dijiye apki report open ho jayegi.
